model_annotation: The image displays a nested donut chart comparing two different metrics related to ambiguity across two concentric rings. Two descriptive legends are positioned to the right of the chart, and percentage labels are displayed directly inside the segments using either white or black text. The outer ring represents "Ambiguity Std" and contains four structural segments distinguished by varying shades of darker blue. Based on the corresponding top legend, the largest outer segment is dark blue ("Std: 0.0") making up 49.0%, followed by a medium-dark blue segment ("Std: 0.47") at 39.0%, a bright blue segment ("Std: 0.94") at 7.0%, and a medium blue segment ("Std: 0.82") at 5.0%. The inner ring represents "Max Ambiguity" and contains three segments delineated by lighter shades of blue. According to the bottom legend, these inner segments appear visually ordered in descending size stretching clockwise from the top: the largest is a medium-light blue slice ("Max: 1") at 47.7%, followed by a light blue slice ("Max: 2") at 38.0%, and a very light blue slice ("Max: 3") at 14.2%. None of the segments in either ring are visually exploded or offset from the main circular structure.
